_comment: Engram hooks fragment. ONE cross-platform SessionStart entry, grafted into the target's .claude/settings.json by both installers: shell 'bash' runs via Git Bash on Windows (ships with Git for Windows, which Engram requires anyway) and native bash on macOS/Linux, so the committed settings.json works for the whole team. On Windows the .sh scripts immediately exec their .ps1 twins (Git Bash process spawns can cost ~1s each, blowing hook timeouts), so the bash registration stays correct AND fast per-OS. PowerShell-only fallback (no Git Bash): replace command with  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/engram-brief.ps1"  and shell with 'powershell'. Note: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} is expanded by the hook's shell from the environment - PowerShell syntax needs $env:, bash needs $ or ${}. The '_autocapture_hooks' key below is OPT-IN documentation/data for the installer ONLY - it is NOT part of the default merge. Re-run the installer with -AutoCapture / --auto-capture to graft those two entries into hooks.PreCompact and hooks.SessionEnd.
_statusline_comment: The Engram status line is deliberately NOT registered here: statusLine is a per-user singleton, and a project-level entry would override every teammate's personal status line. The installers instead copy both statusline twins to ~/.claude/ and register the OS-appropriate one in the USER's ~/.claude/settings.json (install.sh: "bash ~/.claude/engram-statusline.sh"; install.ps1: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:/Users/<you>/.claude/engram-statusline.ps1", because Git Bash spawn cost pushes the bash twin past the status-line timeout on Windows). Registration is skipped if a non-Engram statusLine already exists; install.ps1 upgrades a legacy bash-twin registration in place. The script self-locates the project from the JSON payload, so one user-level registration covers every Engram-fied repo.

_autocapture_hooks._comment: OPT-IN, NOT merged by default. The installer grafts these two entries into hooks.PreCompact and hooks.SessionEnd only when run with -AutoCapture / --auto-capture. Both draft a journal entry from the session transcript via headless Claude (engram-capture). PreCompact is synchronous (timeout 180) so compaction waits for the draft - that is the point. SessionEnd is async with a longer timeout (300) so it never blocks CLI exit.
